sources.title: scyllasband/MODEL_CARD.md at main · lowkeytea/scyllasband
sources.snippet: Scylla's Band Scylla's Band is a multilingual, multi-voice, expressive text-to-speech model for local and self-hosted inference. It predicts phone durations, generates continuous acoustic latents with rectified flow, and decodes those latents to a 24 kHz waveform through a Scylla's Band acoustic adapter and Vocos vocoder.
